in_marathi.name: Dayamayee
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dayamayee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dayamayee is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Daya' (compassion) and 'Mayee' (Mother). This name is dedicated to the compassionate goddess who nurtures and protects her children. It is a tribute to the unending love and kindness of a mother.
